display_name: Rate of return by concentration (CR4) (Demsetz), 1963 and 1969

triage.reason: Faithful reconstruction of Shaikh Figure 8.6 (Ch8, pp.376-377) from Demsetz (1973b, Table 4, p.19): profit rate on assets across six CR4 concentration bins for two snapshot years, 1963 and 1969. Cross-sectional (industries binned by CR4 within each year; the two years are not a continuous index). Construction-relevant: Shaikh's exhibit of the temporal instability of the concentration-profit relation (weak positive in 1963, weak negative in 1969), expected under real competition.
